title: The Last Donut
logline: Friday, 4:59 PM. One donut left in the office. June will do anything to get it — and so will her boss.

characters.name: JUNE
characters.description: Woman, late 20s, an office worker with big energy. Short dark curly hair tied back with a bandana, freckles, strong expressive eyebrows. Oversized striped sweater, loose trousers, white sneakers, an ID lanyard round her neck.

characters.name: OTTO
characters.description: Man, late 60s, the boss. Tall, thin and slightly stooped. Long face, hooked nose, bushy white eyebrows, round wire glasses, neat white moustache. Bald on top with a fringe of white hair. Rumpled suit with a loose striped tie and a coffee mug that says BOSS.

characters.name: BOLT
characters.description: Dog, the office dog. Scruffy medium-sized terrier mix with a wiry coat, one ear up and one ear flopped down, a big dark patch over his left eye, a stubby tail. Wears a too-big collar with a round tag.

shots.action: An empty office kitchen counter. On it, one single glazed donut on a plate, lit by a dramatic beam of light like a treasure. A wall clock reads 4:59.
shots.motion: slow dramatic push in toward the single donut, the light beam glowing, dust sparkling in the air
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.dialogue: Friday. Four fifty-nine. One donut left.

shots.action: JUNE slowly rises into view from behind a cubicle wall, only her eyes and eyebrows showing, eyes narrowed with fierce determination.
shots.motion: the woman slowly rises from behind the cubicle wall, eyes narrowing, eyebrows lowering
shots.speaker: JUNE

shots.action: JUNE army-crawls fast across the office carpet under a row of desks, elbows pumping, like a commando on a mission.
shots.motion: the woman crawls quickly forward on her elbows under the desks like a commando
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.action: JUNE leaps over a robot vacuum cleaner in a dramatic action-movie jump, arms out, sweater flying, the little robot rolling underneath her.
shots.motion: the woman leaps over the robot vacuum in slow motion, arms out, the robot rolls underneath
shots.speaker: JUNE

shots.action: Extreme close-up of the donut on its plate as two hands reach for it from opposite sides — a young woman's hand from the left, an old man's hand with a shirt cuff from the right.
shots.motion: two hands reach in from opposite sides and both grab the donut at the same moment
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.action: JUNE and OTTO face each other across the counter, both gripping the same donut, glaring like gunslingers in a western standoff.
shots.motion: the two of them glare at each other, both tugging the donut, eyes narrowing, tension rising
shots.speaker: OTTO

shots.action: BOLT the dog leaps up high between two people at a kitchen counter, jaws wide open, ears flying, aiming for the donut.
shots.motion: the dog leaps up high, jaws open, ears flapping, and snatches the donut
shots.speaker: JUNE

shots.action: BOLT sprints away across the office with the donut in his mouth while JUNE and OTTO crash into each other chasing him, papers flying everywhere.
shots.motion: the dog runs away with the donut, the two people collide behind him, papers fly into the air
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.action: OTTO sits at his desk and sheepishly slides open a drawer full of donuts. JUNE stands beside him, staring at the drawer, jaw dropped in outrage.
shots.motion: the old man slowly slides open the drawer revealing many donuts, the woman's jaw drops
shots.speaker: OTTO
